description: This file contains automated tests for the Playwright testing framework, specifically testing the behavior and rendering of test attachments (text, screenshot, trace) within the Playwright test runner. It includes various test cases verifying the output and error handling of the 'testInfo.attach' method during test execution.

methods.name: render text attachment
methods.description: Tests rendering output for a text attachment added via testInfo.attach with 'body' as Buffer data.

methods.name: render screenshot attachment
methods.description: Tests rendering output for a screenshot attachment with a file path specified.

methods.name: render trace attachment
methods.description: Tests rendering output for a trace zip attachment with a file path specified.

methods.name: testInfo.attach errors
methods.description: Verifies error handling when using testInfo.attach with invalid or missing file paths.

methods.name: testInfo.attach errors with empty path
methods.description: Checks error response when attaching with an empty path.

methods.name: testInfo.attach error in fixture
methods.description: Tests error handling for attach calls within a fixture after use().

methods.name: testInfo.attach success in fixture
methods.description: Verifies successful attachment within a fixture after creating a file.

methods.name: testInfo.attach allow empty string body
methods.description: Ensures attaching with an empty body string is handled correctly.

methods.name: testInfo.attach allow without options
methods.description: Tests attaching with only a name (string) and no options.

methods.name: testInfo.attach allow empty buffer body
methods.description: Verifies handling of attachment with an empty Buffer body.

methods.name: testInfo.attach use name as prefix
methods.description: Checks that a long name is appropriately converted to a sanitized prefix in output.

methods.name: testInfo.attach name should be sanitized
methods.description: Verifies that attachment names containing path components are sanitized for display.

methods.name: testInfo.attach name can be empty string
methods.description: Checks behavior when attaching with an empty string as the name.

methods.name: testInfo.attach throw if name is not string
methods.description: Verifies error is thrown if the attachment name is not a string.

methods.name: render text attachment with multiple lines
methods.description: Verifies multi-line text bodies are rendered correctly with newlines.

methods.name: attaching inside boxed fixture should not log error
methods.description: Test with a fixture boxed for parallel execution, verifying no 'step id not found' errors occur during testInfo.attach calls.
